population.eligibility.value: All category-year groups with wholesale quotations and sales in data; quoted SKU rates included once
population.eligibility.rationale: No procurement or inventory data; reporting estimated financial model over available observations

value: Net signed sales quantity (returns already negative); exact same date/item quote; no duplicate quotes; include all categories
population.conditions.rationale: Return signs and exact quote coverage observed; no restriction requested

value.description: Simple wholesale quotation average/max/min and max-min difference. Total wholesale price interpreted net quantity times exact daily wholesale unit price; total selling price net quantity times actual selling unit price. Average loss rate simple mean across distinct quoted items per year. Loss estimated as net quantity*wholesale*r/(1-r) for procurement loss rate r; profit=revenue-sold-unit-cost-loss.

measure.formula.rationale: Financial totals and loss denominator undefined; actual procurement unknown. This is disclosed estimate, not accounting fact.

fields.measure.countGrain: Quotes for price mean; distinct quoted items for loss rate mean; transaction rows for revenue and cost
fields.measure.denominator: Count of wholesale quotations for average price; distinct quoted items for average loss rate; 1-r for estimated procurement cost

grouping.quote: for each category within each year
